answer: Each identity pays a 45-credit join fee, burned, to board its first voyage. Its receipt is a signed whisper on the frozen tundra registry, listing key and fee for recount. A second identity needs a second fee; a shared funding key adds 8 per extra identity, so the kth fake pays 45+8(k-1). One thousand fakes burn 4,041,000 against a 40,000 pool. A rented pass fails: the whisper names its owner. An honest agent pays 45 once, keeps its share.
